text:
Overall, the price was good, the staff was good, and the clinic was clean. Personally, I didn't consult directly with the doctor; I spoke with the nurse instead. Regarding the promotional price, they did recommend adding a tip enhancement for +5000฿, but it was up to me and they didn't force me. I'm very afraid of needles, so I asked for numbing cream, and they didn't charge extra. The nurse was polite and courteous.
However, it took a bit too long. I got in line at 9:00 AM and had the procedure done at 6:00 PM. The doctor worked very quickly, but I was a little disappointed and annoyed with the doctor because they didn't let me check the shape before suturing, and the doctor seemed slightly irritated with me because I had difficulty breathing while lying down, which made it difficult for the doctor to work. As for the suturing, it wasn't very neat because the doctor rushed it so much.
Update on my post-procedure condition: there was no bruising at all, but a little swelling from the numbing cream. After 2-3 days, there was a slight bruise, almost invisible. To others, it looks pretty good overall, but personally, I think the tip is slightly crooked, or maybe it's due to the swelling. Also, I felt it wasn't quite what I wanted, but I understand that for this price, this is what you get. I have thin skin, a short nose, and a thin tip.
So, I was a little disappointed and didn't get exactly what I expected. But overall, it was good. I recommend it.

text: This was our first time getting surgery. We booked a promotional package for nose augmentation + alar reduction for 12,990 baht. We paid a 1,000 baht deposit via chat, which we didn't mind. We then asked how much we needed to pay at the clinic, and it was 11,990 baht. We saw the good deal and thought it would be over since we had no prior experience with surgery. We chose this clinic for our first time, but we don't know if other clinics are the same. At that time, there were many other promotions, including a first-time nose augmentation package for 8,990 baht, which said it included artificial tissue grafting. We didn't book that package because we thought we would also get alar reduction, which would only cost a few more baht. However, when we arrived, we had prepared the money – not much extra, but maybe a little – because we had discussed it with the clinic via LINE. We spoke with the counter staff (not the doctor), who assessed our nose shape. The staff told us that if we wanted alar reduction, we would have to pay an additional 8,000 baht. We were confused because we had booked at that price, but why couldn't we get it for that price? The staff recommended a package for us, suggesting a standard silicone implant for 8990 THB plus an additional 5000 THB for artificial tissue. However, the price listed by the clinic was 8990 THB for the basic implant and included artificial tissue. Upon arrival, they said we had to pay extra. We don't understand if the artificial tissue included is actually free, or if they're just adding one layer and asking us to pay for another. On the day we transferred the clinic the agreed-upon amount of 11,190 THB via LINE chat before the procedure, we transferred another 13,990 THB. This exceeded our budget, but we still had enough. We're just confused why we have to pay extra. Maybe we misunderstood, or maybe we didn't listen carefully enough. We just know we didn't get alar reduction surgery, and we're already very disappointed. After the procedure, their page contacted us via LINE, asked to see before and after photos, and then used those photos to post and create a fake account for their own review. Then they took our photos and used them for a review for our clinic. We didn't intend to discredit the clinic in any way, we just wanted to say that we felt disappointed. Or maybe we didn't research enough about what to prepare for our first cosmetic surgery procedure? It might have been our lack of knowledge. Thank you for reading.

text: I'm writing to review my nose revision surgery. I'd been looking at reviews for a while before deciding to book an appointment and have it done on January 4th, 2026. I originally planned to have a chin augmentation and nose revision as per the advertised promotion. I arrived at the clinic at 10:30 AM for my appointment, but the actual surgery was in the afternoon because it was extremely crowded. During the surgery, I didn't get a chance to talk to the doctor at all. I spoke with the staff and explained my plan for two procedures. However, the staff said the price wasn't the advertised price and that there would be additional charges, including an extra 5000 baht for tip refinement. I was puzzled by this. I also inquired about the chin augmentation, and the staff said it was possible, but my chin was recessed, and it would cost extra. So I opted for just the nose revision. Again, the price wasn't the same as advertised. After paying, I went upstairs to wait before I could talk to the doctor and choose the shape. I must say, the doctor's work was gentle, and there was minimal bruising, which was a plus. After the surgery, on the 18th, I wasn't notified of anything. I messaged them on LINE asking if I needed to see the doctor or when I should come back. The staff replied that maybe the doctor didn't have any problems or that I wasn't concerned, so I didn't need to see him. However, we were concerned about the redness at the tip of the nose. The staff explained that if a customer tries on an artificial tissue tip, sometimes the artificial tissue may not blend in completely, and a red edge might be visible due to blood flow to the artificial tissue. I was not impressed with the service and the communication regarding the advertised promotion and the shape of my nose after this rhinoplasty.

I had a nose job at this clinic, so I wanted to share my experience in case it's helpful.

At first, I saw a rather interesting promotion, and it said "free tip correction." But when I arrived, the staff informed me that if I wanted a shape like the reference, I'd have to pay an additional 5,000 baht. I was quite confused, as the promotion already stated that it was included.

Before the procedure:
I didn't have a chance to consult with the doctor in detail.
The staff did most of the talking beforehand, and then I met the doctor for a short while.
They didn't measure my face or explain much. When I looked at the photos, the doctor said, "You can do it, but the tip might not be perfect. If you want it perfect, you'll have to pay more." Then he got me on the bed.

During the actual procedure,
I felt like the doctor was in a rush.
The anesthesia was administered, and in less than two minutes, the surgery began.
I felt a little sore during the incision. Then, when I opened my eyes, the doctor had already left. He didn't explain the technique used or whether the tip correction was actually done.
This made me feel a bit unsure.

The queue and management:
It was quite chaotic, crowded, and unorganized.
I felt like I didn't get the consultation I should have received before the surgery.

I'm still swollen, so I haven't yet determined the results. But overall, I was quite disappointed with my experience.
I'm sharing this here in case anyone else is considering it might need some additional information.
